mapper.select: SELECT t1.koscom_cd AS sjCd , f_sj_nm (t1.koscom_cd) AS xxSjCd , t1.close AS close , t1.volume AS volume , t1.value AS value , t1.preclose AS preclose , t1.spot_price AS spotPrice , t1.calc_price AS calcPrice , t1.change AS change , t1.ymd AS ymd , ' ' AS bigo , 1 AS pVisible FROM sjt1tg t1 WHERE t1.ymd = #{ymd} AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.koscom_cd, 'KR[4]') ORDER BY t1.koscom_cd ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t2.sj_cd AS sjCd , t2.sj_nm AS xxSjCd , t2.koscom_cd AS bigo , NVL(t3.close, 0) AS preclose , #{ymd} AS ymd FROM ssm0km t1 , ssx0kj t2 LEFT OUTER JOIN sjt1tg t3 ON t3.ymd = #{junilYmd} AND t3.koscom_cd = t2.sj_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.sj_cd = t1.sj_cd AND t2.lsy_ymd > #{junilYmd} ORDER BY t2.sj_cd ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t2.sj_cd AS sjCd , t2.sj_nm AS xxSjCd , 0 AS preclose , '신규생성 주식 결제지수' AS bigo FROM ssx0kj t1 , ssx0kj t2 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.lsy_ymd = #{ymd} AND t1.jasan != 'XX' AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.sj_gb = '0' AND t2.jasan = t1.jasan ORDER BY t2.sj_cd ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t2.sj_cd AS sjCd , t2.sj_nm AS xxSjCd , 0 AS preclose , '신규생성 국고채 결제지수' AS bigo FROM ssx0kj t1 , ssx0kj t2 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.lsy_ymd - 1 = #{ymd} AND t1.jasan = 'XX' AND t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.sj_gb = '0' AND t2.jasan = t1.jasan ORDER BY t2.sj_cd ASC
